chapterInfo.content:
14
Yesu sa obi a ɔyare sasaborɔ yadeɛ homeda
1 # Luk 6.6-11; 11.37 Na ɛbaa sɛ homeda bi, ɔkɔɔ Farisifoɔ panin bi fie no, na wɔretɛ no. 2Na hwɛ, na onipa bi wɔ n’anim a ɔyare sasaborɔ. 3Na Yesu see mmarakyerɛfoɔ ne Farisifoɔ no sɛ: Ɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔsa yadeɛ homeda anaasɛ wɔnsa? 4Na wɔyɛɛ komm. Na ɔfaa no saa no yadeɛ, na ɔmaa no kɔe. 5#Luk 13.15; Mat 12.11 Na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Mo mu hwan afunumu anaa nantwie na ɔkɔtɔ abura mu a, ɔrenkɔtwe no ntɛmntɛm homeda? 6Na wɔantumi ammua no yeinom ho bi bio.
Ahobrɛaseɛ
7 # Mat 23.6 Na ɔde n’ani karii wɔn a wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ wɔn adidie no sɛdeɛ wɔpa mu yi mpanimfoɔ tenaberɛ no, ɔbuu wɔn bɛ ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: 8Sɛ obi to nsa frɛ wo ayeforɔ ase a, nkɔtena mpanimfoɔ tenaberɛ! Ebia wɔato nsa afrɛ deɛ n’anim yɛ nyam sene woɔ. 9Na deɛ ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ wo ne no no ba a, ɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ: Ma oyi kwan! Na ɛno na wode aniwuo bɛfiri aseɛ akɔfa akyire tenaberɛ. 10Na sɛ wɔto nsa frɛ wo a, kɔ na kɔtena akyire tenaberɛ! Na deɛ ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ woɔ no ba a, waka akyerɛ wo sɛ: Damfo, twi kɔ soro nohoa! Ɛno na wobɛnya anidie wɔn a wɔne wo te adidiiɛ no anim. 11#Luk 18.14; Mat 23.12 Na obiara a ɔma ne ho soɔ no, wɔbɛbrɛ no ase; na deɛ ɔbrɛ ne ho aseɛ no, wɔbɛma no so.
Ahiafoɔ adidifrɛ
12Na ɔsee deɛ ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ no no nso sɛ: Sɛ woto pono awia anaa anwummerɛ a, mfrɛ wo nnamfo anaa wo nuanom anaa w’abusuafoɔ anaa afipamfoɔ adefoɔ! Na wɔn nso ammɛto nsa amfrɛ wo bi, na woannya so akatua. 13#Deut 14.29 Na woto pono a, frɛ ahiafoɔ, mmubuafoɔ, mpakye ne anifirafoɔ, 14#Yoh 5.29 na woanya nhyira; ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni deɛ wɔde bɛtua wo so ka. Na ateneneefoɔ sɔreɛ mu na wɔbɛtua wo so ka.
Apontoɔ kɛseɛ no
(Mateo 22.2-10)
15 # Luk 13.29 Na wɔn a wɔne no te adidiiɛ no mu baako tee saa no, ɔsee no sɛ: Nhyira ne deɛ ɔbɛdidi Nyankopɔn ahennie mu! 16Na Yesu see no sɛ: Onipa bi too pono kɛseɛ, na ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ nnipa pii. 17Na adidi berɛ duruiɛ no, ɔsomaa n’akoa sɛ ɔnkɔka nkyerɛ wɔn a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn no sɛ: Mommra, na wɔasiesie nnoɔma awie. 18Na wɔn nyinaa firi aseɛ kaa asɛnkorɔ yiyii wɔn ano. Deɛ ɔdi kan see no sɛ: Matɔ afuo, na ɛhia sɛ mekɔhwɛ; mesrɛ wo, yi me firi mu! 19Na ɔfoforɔ se: Matɔ anantwie mpamho nnum, na merekɔsɔ wɔn mahwɛ; mesrɛ wo, yi me firi mu! 20#1 Ko 7.33 Na ɔfoforɔ se: Maware yere, enti merentumi memma. 21Na akoa no ba bɛkaa nsɛm no kyerɛɛ ne wura. Ɛnna efiewura no bo fuiɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’akoa no sɛ: Firi adi ntɛm, kɔ kuro no mmɔntene so ne mmantɛmo, na kɔfa ahiafoɔ, mmubuafoɔ, anifirafoɔ ne mpakye bra! 22Na akoa no se: Owura, mayɛ sɛdeɛ wohyɛeɛ no, nanso ɛfa da so wɔ hɔ. 23Na owura no ka kyerɛɛ akoa no sɛ: Firi adi kɔ akwan so ne ban ho, na kɔhyɛ wɔn na wɔmmra, na me fie ha nyɛ ma. 24Na mese mo sɛ: Nnipa a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn no mu biara renka m’aduane no nhwɛ.
Kristo frɛ a ɔfrɛ nnipa
(Mateo 10.37-38)
25Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii ne no nam. Na ɔdanee ne ho ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: 26#Deut 33.9-10; Luk 18.29-30 Sɛ obi ba me nkyɛn, na ɔntane n’agya ne ne na ne ne yere ne ne mma ne ne nuammarimanom ne ne nuammaanom ne ɔno ara ne ho nso a, ɔntumi nyɛ me suani. 27#Luk 9.23 Na obiara a ɔnsoa n’asɛnnua na ɔnni m’akyire no, ɔntumi nyɛ me suani.
Nkontabuo
28Na mo mu hwan na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔto abantenten, na ɔrentena ase mmu ho nkonta ansa, sɛ ɔwɔ deɛ ɔde bɛtumi awie? 29Ebia wafiri aseɛ no, wantumi anwie a, wɔn a wɔhunu nyinaa bɛfiri aseɛ agoro ne ho 30sɛ: Onipa yi firii aseɛ toe, na wantumi anwie. 31Anaasɛ ɔhene bɛn na ɔne ɔhene bi rekɔko, na ɔntena ase nnwene ho kane, sɛ ɔbɛtumi de ɔpedu akɔhyia deɛ ɔde ɔpeduonu reba ne soɔ no? 32Anyɛ saa a, ɔbaako no wɔ akyirikyiri no, ɔtu abɔfoɔ kɔsrɛ sɛ wɔmpata. 33Saa ara nso na mo mu biara a ɔnnya deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa hɔ ntumi nyɛ me suani. 34#Mat 5.13; Mar 9.50 Nkyene yɛ; nanso sɛ nkyene dɛ tu a, ɛdeɛn na sɛ wɔde to mu a ɛbɛma no ayɛ dɛ bio? 35Ɛmfata fam anaa sumina so, na wɔto gu. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso bɛtie no, ma no ntie!

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɛbaa sɛ homeda bi, ɔkɔɔ Farisifoɔ panin bi fie no, na wɔretɛ no. Na hwɛ, na onipa bi wɔ n’anim a ɔyare sasaborɔ. Na Yesu see mmarakyerɛfoɔ ne Farisifoɔ no sɛ: Ɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔsa yadeɛ homeda anaasɛ wɔnsa? Na wɔyɛɛ komm. Na ɔfaa no saa no yadeɛ, na ɔmaa no kɔe. Na ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Mo mu hwan afunumu anaa nantwie na ɔkɔtɔ abura mu a, ɔrenkɔtwe no ntɛmntɛm homeda? Na wɔantumi ammua no yeinom ho bi bio.

Na ɔde n’ani karii wɔn a wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ wɔn adidie no sɛdeɛ wɔpa mu yi mpanimfoɔ tenaberɛ no, ɔbuu wɔn bɛ ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ obi to nsa frɛ wo ayeforɔ ase a, nkɔtena mpanimfoɔ tenaberɛ! Ebia wɔato nsa afrɛ deɛ n’anim yɛ nyam sene woɔ. Na deɛ ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ wo ne no no ba a, ɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ: Ma oyi kwan! Na ɛno na wode aniwuo bɛfiri aseɛ akɔfa akyire tenaberɛ. Na sɛ wɔto nsa frɛ wo a, kɔ na kɔtena akyire tenaberɛ! Na deɛ ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ woɔ no ba a, waka akyerɛ wo sɛ: Damfo, twi kɔ soro nohoa! Ɛno na wobɛnya anidie wɔn a wɔne wo te adidiiɛ no anim. Na obiara a ɔma ne ho soɔ no, wɔbɛbrɛ no ase; na deɛ ɔbrɛ ne ho aseɛ no, wɔbɛma no so.

Na ɔsee deɛ ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ no no nso sɛ: Sɛ woto pono awia anaa anwummerɛ a, mfrɛ wo nnamfo anaa wo nuanom anaa w’abusuafoɔ anaa afipamfoɔ adefoɔ! Na wɔn nso ammɛto nsa amfrɛ wo bi, na woannya so akatua. Na woto pono a, frɛ ahiafoɔ, mmubuafoɔ, mpakye ne anifirafoɔ, na woanya nhyira; ɛfiri sɛ wɔnni deɛ wɔde bɛtua wo so ka. Na ateneneefoɔ sɔreɛ mu na wɔbɛtua wo so ka.


Na wɔn a wɔne no te adidiiɛ no mu baako tee saa no, ɔsee no sɛ: Nhyira ne deɛ ɔbɛdidi Nyankopɔn ahennie mu! Na Yesu see no sɛ: Onipa bi too pono kɛseɛ, na ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ nnipa pii. Na adidi berɛ duruiɛ no, ɔsomaa n’akoa sɛ ɔnkɔka nkyerɛ wɔn a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn no sɛ: Mommra, na wɔasiesie nnoɔma awie. Na wɔn nyinaa firi aseɛ kaa asɛnkorɔ yiyii wɔn ano. Deɛ ɔdi kan see no sɛ: Matɔ afuo, na ɛhia sɛ mekɔhwɛ; mesrɛ wo, yi me firi mu! Na ɔfoforɔ se: Matɔ anantwie mpamho nnum, na merekɔsɔ wɔn mahwɛ; mesrɛ wo, yi me firi mu! Na ɔfoforɔ se: Maware yere, enti merentumi memma. Na akoa no ba bɛkaa nsɛm no kyerɛɛ ne wura. Ɛnna efiewura no bo fuiɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’akoa no sɛ: Firi adi ntɛm, kɔ kuro no mmɔntene so ne mmantɛmo, na kɔfa ahiafoɔ, mmubuafoɔ, anifirafoɔ ne mpakye bra! Na akoa no se: Owura, mayɛ sɛdeɛ wohyɛeɛ no, nanso ɛfa da so wɔ hɔ. Na owura no ka kyerɛɛ akoa no sɛ: Firi adi kɔ akwan so ne ban ho, na kɔhyɛ wɔn na wɔmmra, na me fie ha nyɛ ma. Na mese mo sɛ: Nnipa a wɔato nsa afrɛ wɔn no mu biara renka m’aduane no nhwɛ.


Na nkurɔfoɔ akuakuo pii ne no nam. Na ɔdanee ne ho ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ obi ba me nkyɛn, na ɔntane n’agya ne ne na ne ne yere ne ne mma ne ne nuammarimanom ne ne nuammaanom ne ɔno ara ne ho nso a, ɔntumi nyɛ me suani. Na obiara a ɔnsoa n’asɛnnua na ɔnni m’akyire no, ɔntumi nyɛ me suani.

Na mo mu hwan na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔto abantenten, na ɔrentena ase mmu ho nkonta ansa, sɛ ɔwɔ deɛ ɔde bɛtumi awie? Ebia wafiri aseɛ no, wantumi anwie a, wɔn a wɔhunu nyinaa bɛfiri aseɛ agoro ne ho sɛ: Onipa yi firii aseɛ toe, na wantumi anwie. Anaasɛ ɔhene bɛn na ɔne ɔhene bi rekɔko, na ɔntena ase nnwene ho kane, sɛ ɔbɛtumi de ɔpedu akɔhyia deɛ ɔde ɔpeduonu reba ne soɔ no? Anyɛ saa a, ɔbaako no wɔ akyirikyiri no, ɔtu abɔfoɔ kɔsrɛ sɛ wɔmpata. Saa ara nso na mo mu biara a ɔnnya deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa hɔ ntumi nyɛ me suani. Nkyene yɛ; nanso sɛ nkyene dɛ tu a, ɛdeɛn na sɛ wɔde to mu a ɛbɛma no ayɛ dɛ bio? Ɛmfata fam anaa sumina so, na wɔto gu. Deɛ ɔwɔ aso bɛtie no, ma no ntie!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
